## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive; confirmation: shallow sector breadth plus narrow leadership among top performers (Top 5 split across only Technology and Healthcare), and a major divergence between 1W and 1M moves on several large names — support for a neutral, wait-for-confirmation stance.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Healthcare leads: TMO ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.14% | 1M: +10.83%), ABBV ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.62% | 1M: +4.87%), ISRG RECOVERY (1W: +8.22% | 1M: -2.06%). Consumer Staples: MO ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.90% | 1M: +11.35%), MNST RECOVERY (1W: +4.04% | 1M: -2.09%). Communication: META ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.00% | 1M: +18.34%), GOOGL RECOVERY (1W: +3.70% | 1M: -0.26%).

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Technology weak: NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -4.26% | 1M: -4.83%), ASML BELOW TREND (1W: -7.36% | 1M: -14.92%), AMAT BELOW TREND (1W: -11.40% | 1M: -22.32%). Financials weak: BAC BELOW TREND (1W: -7.61% | 1M: -8.91%), GS BELOW TREND (1W: -8.83% | 1M: -10.34%), JPM BELOW TREND (1W: -1.63% | 1M: -3.34%). Utilities weakest: VST BELOW TREND (1W: -7.09% | 1M: -3.91%), CEG BELOW TREND (1W: -11.70% | 1M: -6.57%).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: PANW RECOVERY (1W: +12.10% | 1M: -0.03%), ISRG RECOVERY (1W: +8.22% | 1M: -2.06%), ACN ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.87% | 1M: +11.57%), TMO ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.14% | 1M: +10.83%), NOW ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.64% | 1M: +18.79%). Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Technology), style mixed / no clear leadership.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: LRCX BELOW TREND (1W: -14.76% | 1M: -21.70%), ORCL BELOW TREND (1W: -11.43% | 1M: -2.38%), AMAT BELOW TREND (1W: -11.40% | 1M: -22.32%), BAC BELOW TREND (1W: -7.61% | 1M: -8.91%), GS BELOW TREND (1W: -8.83% | 1M: -10.34%). Weakness concentrated in Technology semis and Financials.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strongest 1W movers: PANW RECOVERY (1W: +12.10% | 1M: -0.03%), ISRG RECOVERY (1W: +8.22% | 1M: -2.06%), ACN ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.87% | 1M: +11.57%). Note major divergence: several large-cap names show 1W pickup with 1M weakness (PANW, ISRG, MNST) — tactical moves, not yet broad-based.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed-to-weak: AAPL ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.41% | 1M: +8.78%) and QCOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.78% | 1M: +14.59%) vs NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -4.26% | 1M: -4.83%), AMAT BELOW TREND (1W: -11.40% | 1M: -22.32%), ASML BELOW TREND (1W: -7.36% | 1M: -14.92%); sector tone remains fragile despite pockets of strength.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Under pressure: BAC BELOW TREND (1W: -7.61% | 1M: -8.91%), GS BELOW TREND (1W: -8.83% | 1M: -10.34%), JPM BELOW TREND (1W: -1.63% | 1M: -3.34%) with defensive exceptions V ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.96% | 1M: +3.37%) and MA ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.04% | 1M: +0.98%).

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Constructive but mixed: TMO ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.14% | 1M: +10.83%), ABBV ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.62% | 1M: +4.87%), JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.07% | 1M: +2.37%) while UNH BELOW TREND (1W: -3.94% | 1M: -4.56%) and LLY RECOVERY (1W: +1.21% | 1M: -3.83%) show divergence — sector is a relative defensive anchor.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor selective exposure to Healthcare and Consumer Staples leaders (TMO ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.14% | 1M: +10.83%), ABBV ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.62% | 1M: +4.87%), MO ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.90% | 1M: +11.35%)); reduce exposure to weak Tech semis and pressured Financials (AMAT BELOW TREND, LRCX BELOW TREND, BAC BELOW TREND). Style: mixed / no clear leadership; monitor major divergence and sentiment-price mismatches.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: ACN ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.87% | 1M: +11.57%), TMO ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.14% | 1M: +10.83%), AAPL ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.41% | 1M: +8.78%). BEARISH: AMAT BELOW TREND (1W: -11.40% | 1M: -22.32%), LRCX BELOW TREND (1W: -14.76% | 1M: -21.70%), GS BELOW TREND (1W: -8.83% | 1M: -10.34%).

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Healthcare and Consumer Staples (sector 1W positive); BEARISH: Technology and Financials (sector 1W negative). Breadth reminder: 3/11 sectors positive.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch NVDA at its 1M trend — failure to reclaim would confirm continued BELOW TREND pressure; AAPL holding ABOVE TREND momentum (1M) is a continuation trigger for tech-related longs; AMAT and LRCX reclaiming their 1M trend would be required to alleviate semiconductor downside risk.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
ISRG (+80): EU nod for da Vinci SP — price RECOVERY (1W: +8.22% | 1M: -2.06%) — short-term news confirmed by 1W strength. GOOGL (+60): chip financing chatter — price RECOVERY (1W: +3.70% | 1M: -0.26%) — sentiment aligning with recent pickup. AMAT (+50): India investment headline — price BELOW TREND (1W: -11.40% | 1M: -22.32%) — sentiment-price divergence, watch for distribution vs. turnaround.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
BAC (-50): fee guidance weakness — price BELOW TREND (1W: -7.61% | 1M: -8.91%) — headline confirms downside. GS (-60 listed in top bearish via price) but specifically C (-60) and QCOM (-55) show stress; QCOM (-55) price ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.78% | 1M: +14.59%) — clear sentiment-price divergence to monitor. TSLA (-50): regulatory/legal headline — price CORRECTION (1W: -2.65% | 1M: +5.53%) — watch for follow-through.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with style mixed / no clear leadership. ACN ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.87% | 1M: +11.57%), TMO ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.14% | 1M: +10.83%) and AAPL ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.41% | 1M: +8.78%) are showing relative strength. Key risk is major divergence across large names (PANW, ISRG, AMAT) and sentiment-price disconnects (AMAT +50 news vs BELOW TREND) — watch for trend breaks.
